info.title: Trackfast API
info.description: Trackfast API contract and local pilot implementation. Google sessions require explicit stored membership. Shared hosting and Xero exports remain separate work. See docs/api-contract.md.

get.summary: List projects available to the caller.
get.description: List current project memberships, including archived projects. Cursors expire after 15 minutes and bind to tenant, person, and page size. Repeat the same limit. Each page rechecks membership. This is a live list, not a snapshot.

Live pages ordered by entry ID. Repeat the date bounds and limit with each cursor. Cursors expire after 15 minutes and bind to the account and filters. Use the change feed to retrieve concurrent changes without omissions.

post.summary: Create an entry owned by the caller.

204.description: Deleted. An identical operation retry returns 204.

get.summary: Read the authenticated tenant and person.

200.description: The authenticated scope. Do not cache this response.

get.summary: Read ordered personal changes, including deletions.
get.description: Start without a cursor to receive the current records migrated from older storage and all later changes. Save next_cursor with the received page. It remains valid for later polling, even when has_more is false. Keep the same limit. Checkpoints bind to tenant and person. This development service retains changes and checkpoints indefinitely.

get.summary: List all projects in the administrator tenant.
get.description: Requires an explicit project-administrator grant. Membership must refer to configured people in this tenant. Archive or restore through PUT. No project deletion or access to personal entries is granted.

post.summary: Create a project and assign its members.
post.description: Requires an explicit project-administrator grant. Membership must refer to configured people in this tenant. Archive or restore through PUT. No project deletion or access to personal entries is granted.

get.summary: Read a project and its members.
get.description: Requires an explicit project-administrator grant. Membership must refer to configured people in this tenant. Archive or restore through PUT. No project deletion or access to personal entries is granted.

put.summary: Replace project details and membership atomically.
put.description: Requires an explicit project-administrator grant. Membership must refer to configured people in this tenant. Archive or restore through PUT. No project deletion or access to personal entries is granted.

post.summary: Create a single-use Google sign-in challenge.
Exchange a verified Google identity for a Trackfast session.
Rotate the session tokens. Reuse revokes the session.
Revoke the session using its refresh token.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist one key per mutation. Retry the same request with the same key. Different content returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Use the last ETag. Missing values return 428. Stale values return 412. Identical operation retries replay first.

From.name: from_date
From.description: Inclusive start date. Must not exceed to_date.

Error400.description: Malformed request or missing operation key.

Error404.description: The resource is unavailable in this scope.

Error409.description: The operation key conflicts or the entry is locked.

Error422.description: Field values or cross-field rules are invalid.
